selected.assay: bulk mRNA-seq (TruSeq stranded, NovaSeq 52-bp PE), quadriceps muscle, male C57BL/6NTac mice on western diet
selected.sample_inclusion: 2^3 full factorial, 8 groups x 8 mice = 64; 2 mice removed (stroke at surgery; button infection) -> 62 (S4.3.2.p1, S4.4.1.p1)
selected.primary_estimand: Main effect of 4 weeks of voluntary wheel running (VWR vs sedentary) on quadriceps gene expression, averaged over the NR and PT arms; wheels locked before the last dark phase, so a chronic training effect, not acute exercise
planned_contrasts: VWR main effect (S2.6.p3; paper: 2,245 protein-coding genes at q < 0.05)
NR main effect (S2.6.p1; paper: 4 protein-coding genes: Nmrk2 down, Art3, Myh8, Mymk up)
NR x PT x VWR interactions (S2.6.p1; paper: none at q < 0.05)
selected.paper_method: edgeR v3.30.3 quasi-likelihood NB GLM, ~ group + RIN, group = 4 (or 8) combinations of NR, VWR (and PT); effects from contrasts between group levels; FDR q-values (S4.4.10.p3)

paper_results.VWR: 2,245 protein-coding genes q < 0.05; Art3 down (q=0.019), Mymk down (q=0.006); Cd38, Sirt3, Sirt5 up; NAD+ synthesis genes (Nmrk1, Nmrk2, Nmnat1, Nmnat3, Nadsyn1, Naprt, Qprt, Nampt) unchanged
paper_results.NR: Nmrk2 down about 65%, Art3 up, Myh8 up, Mymk up
paper_results.GO: camera GO, top-10 terms up with VWR (Fig 6J)

decisions.reason: S4.3.2.p1 describes the 2x2x2 factorial with VWR as the exercise factor; S4.4.10.p3 gives the edgeR QL model ~ group + RIN with group-level contrasts; S2.6.p1/p3 give q < 0.05 counts restricted to protein-coding genes. The methods say 4 (or 8) groups without saying which model produced the VWR count; the main figures pool PT (PT had no effect), so both variants are run.

contrasts.name: train_main_VWR_vs_SED
contrasts.expr: mean of the 4 VWR cells - mean of the 4 SED cells

contrasts.name: nr_main_NR_vs_Sal
contrasts.expr: mean of the 4 NR cells - mean of the 4 saline cells

contrasts.name: pt_main_PT_vs_noPT
contrasts.expr: mean of the 4 PT cells - mean of the 4 noPT cells

contrasts.name: VWR simple effects within each NR x PT cell

decisions.reason: S4.3.2.p1: balanced 2^3 factorial; S4.4.10.p3: one group-means model over all cells, effects found by comparing the levels encoded by group. S2.6.p1 reports main effects because no interaction reached q < 0.05. The exercise estimand is the VWR main effect averaged over NR and PT; the four planned simple effects are its components. Every cell has 7-8 mice.

covariates.name: rin
covariates.disposition: included as a continuous covariate, as in the paper's ~ group + RIN (S4.4.10.p3)

covariates.name: cohort
covariates.disposition: not included: the paper does not model it; balanced across VWR (15/16 per cohort); checked in the confounding report only

covariates.name: purification_pool, day_of_termination, time_of_termination
covariates.disposition: not included: not in the paper's model

decisions.reason: One sample per independent mouse, no repeated measures. The paper adjusts for RIN only; other recorded processing columns are not added because of their names.

deviations: low-expression filter not stated in the paper; filterByExpr applied as the edgeR manual recommends (assumption)
main effect computed as the mean of the 4 VWR cells minus the mean of the 4 SED cells; the paper does not state its contrast weights

decisions.reason: Raw featureCounts counts support the paper's edgeR QL route directly; tools.r_de_tools:run_r_de with engine edger_ql runs R edgeR on an arbitrary design with makeContrasts expressions, so the main-effect contrast over the cell-means model is expressible.

selected.deviation_note: the paper counts only protein-coding genes; our tables include all GENCODE genes passing filterByExpr, so a protein-coding subset count is reported separately in HANDBACK.md

decisions.reason: S2.6.p1 and S2.6.p3: q-value cutoff 0.05 (FDR), no fold-change rule.
Paper's edgeR QL ~ group + RIN on the 8 cells; VWR main effect as the mean VWR-minus-SED difference over the NR x PT cells.
Paper's NR and PT main effects from the same model, as a check that the reconstruction reproduces the paper's non-exercise results (4 and 0 genes).
VWR interactions (paper: none at q < 0.05) and the four VWR simple effects (components of the main effect), from the same model.

selected.method: edgeR QL (R), TMM, ~ 0 + grp4 + rin (PT pooled)

decisions.reason: The paper's 4-combination variant (NR x VWR, PT pooled), in case the reported VWR count came from it.
